text:
camille: quick heads-up — seeing a spike in schema rejections from the new tool-binding adapter on the latency route. customers hit fallback frequently. sample log: ```{\n  \"tool\": \"file_uploader\",\n  \"error\": \"payload_missing_field\",\n  \"schema_version\": \"v2\"\n}``` We currently classify these as 5xx and route to small-model fallback, which inflates fallback cost and hides user-error signals.
raj: do we have counts by route? latency route vs cost route?
camille: yes — prometheus shows a 12% reject rate on /route/fast-path over last 30m, mostly from file_uploader and calendar_write adapters. tracing shows adapter returned 400-ish error but we transformed to 503 at dispatch.
marta: UX question — console needs a dedicated "validation rejects" timeseries (per-route, per-tool) + example payload link so SEs can repro. can we add that without exploding cardinality?
tomas: from infra side, classification matters for throttles/quotas. If we mark these as client errors they shouldn't count against fallback budget nor be rate-limited the same way. but we need a clear policy: if adapter returned structured schema failure vs internal exception.
yuki: proposal: add an ErrorClassification header from adapters: `X-Adapter-Error-Type: user_input|contract|internal` then router uses that to decide routing/telemetry. lightweight and opt-in.
raj: neat. two follow-ups: 1) what about old adapters that don't send header? 2) how to surface mismatch examples in console?
camille: fallback plan for 1: heuristic based on status code + body shape (if body contains `schema`/`missing_field` keywords treat as contract). For 2: console should show sample request/response (redacted) for a small sample window and link to S3 artifact. we can toggle sample retention per-customer to control costs.
marta: design note: in the rollout UX we should show a "classification preview" toggle during canary so SRE/product can see how many calls would flip classifications before enabling. similar to feature flag preview.
ci-bot: deploy requested by camille: /deploy router v1.14-canary to us-east-1
camille: not yet — hold. i want tests first. we need telemetry: 1) per-route reject_rate 2) per-tool reject_reason breakdown 3) fraction classified-by-header vs heuristic 4) quota_impact (does this count toward reserved capacity?)
yuki: telemetry schema draft: ```metric: validation.rejects{route,tool,classification_source,reason} counter``` will also emit label `counts_as_quota: true|false` when emission occurs.
raj: are we comfortable with adding `counts_as_quota` label? that'll increase metrics cardinality and PromQL complexity.
tomas: we can emit a derived metric `validation.quota_counted_rejects` to avoid more labels. keep base metric low-card.
camille: OK action items: - yuki to prototype header + heuristic (PR) - marta to wire sample-view in console mockups - tomas to propose metric name set and prometheus retention plan - raj to update routing docs about classification -> routing/quotas mapping
marta: I'll add a small mock that shows canary preview and sample links.
yuki: i'll open PR with adapter header, heuristic, and unit tests. suggest a 2-week canary.
raj: add an automated alert when preview flip rate > 5% during canary.
camille: thanks — ping me when PRs are linked. :thumbsup:
ci-bot: camille requested reviewers: @raj @yuki @tomas
camille: also — small note for billing: we need to decide if client-contract rejects are billable tokens. finance asked. leaning to non-billable for now but want legal to confirm.
raj: finance + legal sync after we lock classification behavior.
marta: ok i've sketched UI copy for consoles: "Validation rejects" with examples and "Mark as client error" checkbox for flagged adapters.
camille: perfect — that's it for now. keeping thread for rollout coordination and telemetry design.
__notes: follow-up: ensure file name uses unique wording and thread contains only inline messages as required by agents.md
